headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?

headline: Independent Football Regulator chief: Man City guilty verdict 'raises serious issues'
description: Manchester City's guilty verdict for breaching Premier League financial rules "raises serious issues", according to the chair of English football's independent regulator.

headline: FA charges Fulham boss Álvaro Arbeloa with misconduct for comments after Man United draw
description: Fulham boss Alvaro Arbeloa has been charged with misconduct by the FA  for claiming officials would "not let Manchester United lose" after Michael Carrick's side scored a late equaliser to draw their Premier League match at Craven Cottage.

headline: Man City vs. Premier League: 115 financial charges explained
description: The sporting world is waiting for a resolution to the hearings on Man City's charges for allegedly breaching the Premier League's financial rules. Here's what we know, and what might come next.

headline: Pep Guardiola after Man City guilty verdict: 'I am behind my club'
description: Pep Guardiola has released his first statement since Manchester City were found guilty of over 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules, saying "I am behind my club."

headline: Does Man City's guilty verdict impact Pep Guardiola's legacy as an all-time coaching great?
description: Pep Guardiola won 16 major honors as Man City manager. They all now count for nothing after the Premier League found the club guilty of systematically breaking financial rules.
